Class ResourceClimateSectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.resource.ResourceClimateSectionBuilder
public class ResourceClimateSectionBuilder extends Object
Autonomous UI Controller and Section Builder for Climate, Atmospheric, and Precipitation Domains.

Extracted from ResourceDistributionPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Encapsulates the macro-climatic modeling and observation layer:

  • Surface Temperature Field: Mean Annual Temperature (MAT, \(-50^\circ\mathrm{C}\) to \(+50^\circ\mathrm{C}\)), thermal inertia, and latitudinal insolation gradients.
  • Hydrological Precipitation: Mean Annual Precipitation (MAP, \(0\) to \(3\,000\ \mathrm{mm/yr}\)) and humidity regimes.
  • Thermal Seasonality: Seasonal temperature variance (\(\Delta T_{\mathrm{annual}}\), \(0^\circ\mathrm{C}\) to \(50^\circ\mathrm{C}\)) driven by orbital obliquity and spin-orbit resonances.
  • Empirical WMS Ingestion: Satellite ingestion from NASA MODIS (Land Surface Temperature) and NASA/JAXA GPM IMERG (Global Precipitation Measurement).
